description: A large commercial database of life cycle inventory data for industrial processes and products. The ecoinvent pages say the database holds more than 26,000 peer-reviewed datasets modelling human activities and processes across sectors; version 3.12 updated fuels, electricity, chemicals and plastics, waste, metals, textiles, forestry, agriculture, transport, pulp and paper and batteries. Data are linked in three system models (cut-off, APOS and consequential) and cover unit processes, life cycle inventories and impact results. Access is through yearly licences (single-user, enterprise, developer and educational) via the ecoQuery portal, an API, or partner LCA software; it is not a free download, and prices are given on request. Coverage is global with regional process variants. Caveats: cumulative results are open only to licensees and the licence terms are in an end user licence agreement. For simulation it gives the input chains of industrial processes, to trace which supply chains a disrupted plant or material affects. A related catalogue record is the openLCA platform.
